en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town street with a large multi‑storey school building on the left, fenced yard and several smaller wooden houses further down the road. There are a few people walking and children near the school. Telephone poles line the unpaved road. In the upper right corner, printed text reads "Elverum. Folkeskolen." indicating it is showing the public school in Elverum.
